question: Study all genes with salivary-gland consensus RNA nTPM >=1 in HPA; do not additionally require tissue enrichment, enhancement or another specificity category. Report the cohort size, counts by RNA tissue specificity category, the number of FDA approved drug targets and counts measured by blood immunoassay, by mass spectrometry, by both and by neither. Among cohort genes secreted to blood, rank twelve by log2((salivary gland nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1)), ties by Ensembl ID. Give their consensus nTPM in salivary gland, liver, pancreas and kidney, their specificity categories and the available blood concentrations. Draw a specificity-category bar chart, a blood-assay-coverage chart and the four-tissue heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

{"query": "WITH c AS (SELECT r."Gene" ensg FROM rna_tissue_consensus r WHERE r.Tissue='salivary gland' AND TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE) >= 1)
SELECT
 count(*) total,
 sum(CASE WHEN (p."Protein class" LIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fda,
 sum(CASE WHEN p."Blood concentration - Conc. blood IM [pg/L]" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) im_master,

 sum(CASE WHEN exists (SELECT 1 FROM blood_immunoassay_concentration b WHERE b."ENSG ID"=p.Ensembl) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) im_file,
 sum(CASE WHEN exists (SELECT 1 FROM blood_ms_concentration b WHERE b."ENSG ID"=p.Ensembl) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ms_file
FROM c JOIN proteinatlas p ON p.Ensembl=c.ensg"}

turns.text: The cross-tabulation confirms the numbers check out. Now I'll rank the 522 cohort genes by their salivary-to-liver expression ratio, breaking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH c AS (SELECT r."Gene" ensg, TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE) sal
           FROM rna_tissue_consensus r WHERE r.Tissue='salivary gland' AND TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE)>=1)
SELECT c.ensg, p."Gene",
 log2((c.sal+1)/(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(l."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0)+1)) score,
 c.sal, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(l."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0) liv,
 COALESCE(TRY_CAST(k."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0) kid,
 COALESCE(TRY_CAST(pa."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0) pan
FROM c JOIN proteinatlas p ON p.Ensembl=c.ensg
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus l ON l."Gene"=c.ensg AND l.Tissue='liver'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus k ON k."Gene"=c.ensg AND k.Tissue='kidney'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus pa ON pa."Gene"=c.ensg AND pa.Tissue='pancreas'
WHERE p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
ORDER BY score DESC, c.ensg ASC LIMIT 12"}

{"query": "WITH c AS (SELECT r."Gene" ensg, TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE) sal

SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY log2((c.sal+1)/(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(l."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0)+1)) DESC, c.ensg ASC) rn,

FROM c JOIN proteinatlas p ON p.Ensembl=c.ensg
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus l ON l."Gene"=c.ensg AND l.Tissue='liver'
WHERE p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
QUALIFY rn BETWEEN 11 AND 14 ORDER BY rn"}

LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus l ON l."Gene"=c.ensg AND l.Tissue='liver'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus k ON k."Gene"=c.ensg AND k.Tissue='kidney'
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus pa ON pa."Gene"=c.ensg AND pa.Tissue='pancreas'
WHERE p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
ORDER BY score DESC, c.ensg ASC LIMIT 12

WITH c AS (SELECT r."Gene" ensg, TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE) sal
           FROM rna_tissue_consensus r WHERE r.Tissue='salivary gland' AND TRY_CAST(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE)>=1)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY log2((c.sal+1)/(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(l."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0)+1)) DESC, c.ensg ASC) rn,
 c.ensg, p."Gene", log2((c.sal+1)/(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(l."nTPM" AS DOUBLE),0)+1)) score
FROM c JOIN proteinatlas p ON p.Ensembl=c.ensg
LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus l ON l."Gene"=c.ensg AND l.Tissue='liver'
WHERE p."Secretome location"='Secreted to blood'
QUALIFY rn BETWEEN 11 AND 14 ORDER BY rn
